title: Good Morning.wav by barrigan
author: barrigan
sourceDescription: Recording of approx. 250 adults talking before a large meeting. You can hear the general "roar" and occasionally pick out individual voices (but not so much as you can make out what they are saying). All with someone speaking with amplification to get the crowd's attention: "good morning". The crowd begins to quiet and someone tentatively claps.
modifications: cut 0.15-6.15s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -21.10 dBFS); 30 ms fades
